[Hiring] Remote Assistant Needed

Hi! I'm in need of a remote assistant. Pay is $15/hr, on a task by task basis. Some tasks may include: \- Culling photos for real estate photography \- Customer outreach. For drafting services in the AEC industry, and for real estate photography \- Social media posts \- Small odds and ends / random tasks Experience aligned with any of these is certainly great, but the main thing I'm looking for is someone to take the initiative and put in effort, and figure out tasks. If that sounds like you, please shoot me a message with your rate, timezone.   submitted
